body: **Foco:** Concessive structures (Much as I admire…) — introdução.
**Expressões:** a fundamental shift.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (análises).
**Texto do dia:** anúncio, folheto, aviso.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar estruturas concessivas (Much as I admire…, Try as he might…, Strange as it may seem…) e a expressão a fundamental shift.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Join the Debating Society: Where Opinions Meet
lines: **Much as we admire** confidence, we value listening more. **Try as you might**, you cannot win every argument; **tired as you may be**, you can always learn. **Strange as it may seem**, our best debaters began as shy listeners.

**Whatever** your view, **however** strong your doubts, you will find a chair. This term’s motion marks **a fundamental shift** in our program: debates will have **two winners**, the best speaker and the best listener. **Though** places are limited, newcomers are welcome.

items.q: The society values confidence more than listening.
This term there will be two winners.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Much as I admire** her, I disagree.
**Tired as I was**, I kept working.
**Try as he might**, he could not win.
**Strange as it may seem**, it worked.

blocks.body: **Much as = although/ even though** (concessão): o verbo da oração com *as* vai no **sujeito + verbo** normal. Em *Tired as I was*, o adjetivo vem **antes** de *as*.
✗ *Although much as I admire…* (não repita a concessão).

items.s: ___ as I admire her, I disagree. (Much)
___ as it may seem, it worked. (Strange)
Try as he ___ , he could not win. (might)
___ strong your doubts, you will find a chair. (However)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: I am shy Can I still join
items.pt: Sou tímido. Posso entrar mesmo assim?

body: **a fundamental shift** — uma mudança fundamental
**Much as I hate to say it,…** — Por mais que eu odeie dizer,…
**Granted that…** — Admitindo que…
**For all that,…** — Apesar de tudo,…
**Notwithstanding…** — Não obstante…
**Be that as it may** — Seja como for
**Admittedly,…** — Admito que…
**Come what may** — Aconteça o que acontecer
**I am shy. Can I still join?** — Sou tímido. Posso entrar mesmo assim?
**Will I have to speak?** — Terei que falar?
**Shy as you may be, you can learn a lot here.** — Por mais tímido que você seja, pode aprender muito aqui.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.model: Much as I admire her, I think she is wrong.
Try as I might, I cannot remember his name.
However hard it is, we must try.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence club advertisement with at least four concessive structures.
blocks.model: Much as we love tradition, we believe in change. Tired as you may be after work, come and join us. Strange as it may seem, silence is our favourite sound. However shy you are, there is a chair for you. Try as you might, you will not find a friendlier group. This term marks a fundamental shift in our program.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
